purpose: Retrospective 30-case benchmark. This dataset was subsequently used during healthcare-child calibration and is no longer eligible as an untouched holdout.

benchmark_policy.protocol: Do not report this dataset as holdout performance or use it for model selection. It may be used only for regression diagnostics with its contamination disclosed.
benchmark_policy.contamination_note: docs/FORENSIC_HEALTHCARE_CHILD_CALIBRATION_2026-05-20.md records calibration and regression work on the default 29 cases plus this 30-case file.
benchmark_policy.notes: Cases use FBI active-shooter annual reports as the factual source for local time, location, casualties, location category, and visible relationship context. Coordinates are event-location approximations used for chart replay, not exact survey coordinates.
